# Represent Commercial

> Principal-led commercial property management, leasing, buyer’s agency and tenant representation in Brisbane, with broader South East Queensland capability. Office, retail and industrial. Typically working with commercial assets valued from $1 million to $10 million. Led by Nick O'Toole, Principal and Licensee, with 20+ years of owner-side commercial property experience. Real Estate Agent Licence 4949809.

## Brand
- Master brand: Exclusively on your side of the table.
- Supporting service descriptor: Property Management, Leasing, Buyer’s Agency & Tenant Representation.

## Services
1. Commercial Property Management — property management delivered with an asset-management mindset
2. Commercial Leasing — owner-side leasing of vacant commercial space
3. Buyer’s Agency & Acquisition Advisory — independent buyer representation, never acting for the vendor
4. Tenant Representation — tenant-side representation for occupiers, initially focused on office
